held.title: Google Cloud makes spend caps generally available
reasons: Fact check: The item says limits can be applied through policy; the sources describe API-based programmatic setup but do not state policy support.

held.title: AWS exposes Step Functions workflows as tools for AI agents
reasons: Fact check: Before: Teams wrote Lambda adapters or MCP servers to expose Step Functions; the sources say these are no longer needed but do not establish what teams previously did or had to do.
Fact check: Before: Teams encoded business sequences in agents; the sources do not say this was the prior approach.
Fact check: WhyCare: Step Functions preserves execution history without qualification; the documentation specifies execution history for Standard workflows, not Express workflows.

held.title: LangChain adds browser use and async subagents to Managed Deep Agents
reasons: Fact check: Before: Teams needed a separate browser service to use JavaScript-driven websites without APIs; the sources describe the new managed browser but do not establish this prior requirement.

held.title: AWS lets ECS tasks share NVIDIA GPUs through MPS
reasons: Fact check: The item says AWS announced this on 27 October; the What's New page gives no day in its text, and its URL specifies only October 2026.

held.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra, a lower-cost long-context model
reasons: Fact check: The item says OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra on 26 October, but neither readable source dates OpenAI's release; AWS says it announced Bedrock general availability.
Fact check: The item says teams could previously use GPT-6.1 Sol and Luna and had no Terra tier, but neither readable source mentions Luna or establishes that prior state.

held.title: AWS adds domain and location controls to Bedrock Web Search
reasons: Fact check: The item says the change was announced on 23 October 2026 | Neither source states the announcement day; the AWS URL identifies only October.

held.title: Google Cloud adds OpenAI models to Model Garden
reasons: Fact check: The item dates the announcement to 21 October, but the readable Google Cloud source does not state an announcement date.
Fact check: The before field says teams managed OpenAI inference separately from Google's catalog, billing, and controls, but the source does not describe that prior arrangement.

held.title: IBM updates Granite Speech models for multilingual, on-device transcription
reasons: Fact check: The item says IBM released Granite Speech 5.0 2B on 21 October, but its model card gives the release date as 20 October; the blog announcement was published on 21 October.
Fact check: The after field says both the 2B and 470M variants run through common runtimes, but these sources document runtime support only for the 2B model.
